hints.title: Granular Timestamp Prefix Matching
hints.text: Filter timestamps by truncation up to the designated granularity level without parsing dates into complex formats.

hints.title: Index Slicing by Granularity
hints.text: Granularity defines string slice endpoints: Year is 4, Month is 7, Day is 10, Hour is 13, Minute is 16, Second is 19. Compare slices lexicographically.

hints.title: LogSystem Blueprint
hints.text: In init: logs = []. In put(id, timestamp): append (id, timestamp). In retrieve(start, end, granularity): idx = indexMap[granularity], s = start[:idx], e = end[:idx], return [id for id, ts in logs if s <= ts[:idx] <= e].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Insertion is O(1); retrieval filters N logs using string slice comparisons.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Parsing full date objects on each operation incurs unnecessary conversion overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores logs linearly with constant-size granularity dictionary.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of standard ISO timestamp fixed-width prefixes for lexicographic filtering.

solutions.approach: C++ Substring Filter for Granular Logs
